name: codex-ui-customizer
description: Customize Codex message styling and safely manage standard file-link opening, including Remote-SSH sessions.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Workspace-defined UI customization values are disabled in Restricted Mode.

commands.title: Codex UI Customizer: Show Target and Status

codexUiCustomizer.plainTextPaste.enabled.description: Enable Ctrl+Shift+V to insert only clipboard text in the Codex composer, preserving normal Ctrl+V. Run Apply and reload the window. Remove restores the managed WebView module.

codexUiCustomizer.fileLinks.excludedExte.description: Extensions to open with Codex's original text handler, such as md or .txt. Case-insensitive; the leading dot is optional. Uses the final filename extension. Changes affect subsequent clicks without reloading once file-link customization is installed.

codexUiCustomizer.fileLinks.enabled.description: Select standard file-link handling for Apply: use VS Code's default editor and reveal the file in Explorer when no line/column is specified. Apply restores the managed original when disabled. Remove restores all managed customizations without changing this setting.

codexUiCustomizer.autoApply.description: Apply CSS, selected file-link handling and plain-text paste on startup and configuration/extension changes. Remove suspends automatic application until Apply is run, without changing settings.

codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.background.patternErrorMessage: Use a 3, 4, 6, or 8 digit hexadecimal color.
codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.background.description: Background color for user message bubbles, as a hexadecimal color.

codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.borderColo.patternErrorMessage: Use a 3, 4, 6, or 8 digit hexadecimal color.
codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.borderColo.description: Border color for user message bubbles, as a hexadecimal color.

codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.borderWidt.patternErrorMessage: Use 0 or a non-negative length in px, rem, or em.
codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.borderWidt.description: Border width for user message bubbles. Supports px, rem, and em.

codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.borderRadi.patternErrorMessage: Use 0 or a non-negative length in px, rem, or em.
codexUiCustomizer.userMessage.borderRadi.description: Border radius for user message bubbles. Supports px, rem, and em.
